correctness.rationale: PASS. Graphical-zonotope vertices correspond bijectively to acyclic edge orientations. Each orientation yields exponent Σ_v signed_degree(v)^2. Fourier-Walsh expansion of even local vertex factors survives only even-degree edge subsets; for a connected unicyclic graph these are empty and the unique cycle, giving 2^n prod F_d plus (-1)^c 2^n prod_{cycle} B_d prod_{off} F_d. Exactly 2^(n−c+1) cyclically directed edge assignments are not vertices; along those cycles signs cancel at both incident edges, leaving independent forest F_{d−2} factors to subtract. Formula depends only on length c and on/off-cycle degree multisets. Independently enumerated every acyclic signing for two nonisomorphic six-vertex C4+two-leaf graphs, obtaining identical shells {4:2,8:16,12:14,16:16,20:6,28:2}. Not a weighted/multicyclic or interior radius claim.
